stories.title: OpenAI Model Wrote Its Own Network Code to Get Around Sandbox Restrictions
stories.description: After its sandbox proxy failed, an internal OpenAI model crafted raw packets and probed AWS services trying to reach the internet.

stories.title: ARTEX AI Hacking Framework Found on 1,465 Public Servers, Some Hosting Cyberattack Tools
stories.description: Researchers found 1,465 exposed ARTEX AI penetration-testing hosts, some containing C2 tools, phishing software, and exploit files.

stories.title: Claude Dispatch Flaw Lets Malicious Browser Extensions Run Code on Connected Computers
stories.description: A flaw in Anthropic's Claude Dispatch let a malicious browser extension run commands on a computer via Claude Desktop. That computer could even be a different machine signed into the same Claude account.

stories.title: Hackers Could Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Steal Conversations Without Users Knowing
stories.description: A flaw in ChatGPT let attackers slip past Lockdown Mode, the safety setting meant to stop data leaks. Check Point Research found that a hidden pop-up trick could copy a user's full chat history, show fake windows, and push malware.

stories.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services
stories.description: Chainalysis says an agentic cyberattack exposed all users' names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens, prompting service shutdowns.

stories.title: Top 10 Best Deception Technology Solutions in 2026 [Ranked & Scored]
stories.description: A tripped decoy is the highest-fidelity alert in security — we ranked the 10 best deception technology solutions of 2026 on signal purity and deploy cost.

stories.title: Hackers Hide Linux Backdoor in Control Web Panel Server to Execute Commands Without Logs
stories.description: CWPdoor replaces Control Web Panel's web server after root access, enabling command execution through requests hidden from access logs.

stories.title: Experts Demonstrate Barracuda Email Security Gateway Chain Enabling Root Access Without Login
stories.description: Two patched Barracuda Email Security Gateway flaws can be chained to execute root commands without authentication, watchTowr demonstrated.

stories.title: 3 Charged in Scheme to Use AI to Impersonate CEOs and Attorneys to Steal $129 Million
stories.description: The trio, who have nicknames that include “Rocky Balboa,” “Superman Cash” and “Fat Boy,” often targeted the companies’ accounting departments.

stories.title: AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research
stories.description: An unreleased OpenAI cyber model found and exploited 948 distinct Linux kernel privilege escalation bugs for about $1.2 million.

stories.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
stories.description: OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes a critical password bypass allowing access to key-only accounts on affected Alpine Linux servers using long passwords.
